stepNotes.1: Single-file unit at packages/ax-code/src/ide/index.ts; Ide namespace exposes Event.Installed, two NamedError subclasses, and three functions ide/alreadyInstalled/install backed by a 5-entry SUPPORTED_IDES table.
stepNotes.2: Repo-wide grep shows Ide is imported only by its own test (packages/ax-code/test/ide/ide.test.ts:2); no production or desktop caller — desktop/electron/src/main.js:1184 keeps its own IDE launcher table.
stepNotes.3: ide() relies on substring matching of GIT_ASKPASS via v?.includes(ide.name) at line 41; SUPPORTED_IDES correctly orders Insiders before stable so the more specific name wins; arbitrary path-component collisions could mis-detect.
stepNotes.4: install() runs cmd from the static SUPPORTED_IDES list in array form with nothrow, so no shell-injection surface; no network, no secrets, log.info at line 61 emits CLI stdout/stderr which is non-sensitive for this command.
stepNotes.5: All three exports are trivial: two are sync env-string comparisons and one spawns a single short-lived child process; no hot path, no allocation concerns.
stepNotes.6: Coupling is bounded to six first-party deps plus zod; Ide.Event.Installed is registered into the BusEvent union (bus-event.ts:9-16) but no producer anywhere emits ide.installed — the contract reserves a slot nobody publishes.
stepNotes.7: Dominant issue: install(), InstallFailedError, AlreadyInstalledError and Event.Installed are all unreachable from production; literal 'sst-dev.ax-code' at line 55 is a hardcoded extension id that would belong in constants if revived.
stepNotes.8: ide.test.ts (82 LOC, 11 cases) covers ide() and alreadyInstalled() branches cleanly with process.env snapshot/restore, but install() has zero coverage and neither named error is ever constructed or asserted.
stepNotes.9: No Critical findings — reverify.md not required; MEDIUM items are orphaned install path and never-emitted event; LOW items are substring fragility, missing Windows cmd parity vs desktop main.js, and absent install() tests; disposition deferred to module owner.
